decision: Do not adopt tracker metadata exact_duplicate or upload-slot rules as exact local file equality. Preserve explicit incomplete outcomes and byte confirmation.
observed_scope: Existing regression tests equal bytes across extensions and rejects same-size one-byte differences, including middle of128KiB fixture, both scan and scan_verified, reversed input order. scan_folder directly calls scan_verified and exits1 on incomplete report.
limits: One existing focused regression executed; not all library tests, formats, platforms, performance or500-repository completion. No implementation change; no upstream code adopted.
